descriptionByLocale.en:
Do you consider yourself a creative person and looking to learn more about the world of marketing? Do you have an special interest for events organization? Do you want to learn more on how the planning, content, logistics and execution of marketing events and other activities across the continent can add value to our clients?

We’re looking for a marketing intern to help us:

• support the plan, development and execution of marketing projects.
• support administrative tasks for execution of UBS events in Latin America.
• work collaboratively with internal partners across internal/corporate communications, brand, media, web platforms, external agency partners, and third-party event partners.
• produce client literature including factsheets, presentations, email invitations, event announcements, among others.
• make sure marketing materials comply with our brand guidelines, policies and regulatory requirements.
